cases.name: exact local preference default, encoding and reload rule
mounted off-on-off survives deferred first save, poll, profile replacement and stale acknowledgement
stale rejection is fenced and newer queued save succeeds
latest rejection rolls back to last confirmed value and reports failure
poll establishes native rollback reference without owning the visible local value

ordering.nativeMirror: serialized through the existing local_config_set command; a later local revision fences a late/stale earlier acknowledgement or rejection
ordering.outOfOrderNativeAcknowledgements: structurally prevented because request N+1 is not dispatched until request N settles
ordering.latestFailure: reconciles local storage and visible state to the last native-confirmed value and reports the failure

preserved.autoReconnect: unchanged acknowledged/profile-scoped callback and Home disabled predicate
preserved.unrelatedConfig: Auto Launch callback never calls setLocalConfig; polled Auto Reconnect survives Auto Launch acknowledgements and rollback
preserved.fiveSecondPoll: still executes; it refreshes native config without replacing the source-local Auto Launch value
preserved.profileReplacement: global local Auto Launch draft persists while selected profile effects refresh independently
